title: Define OpenAPI v1 baseline
description: Create `openapi.yaml` for critical endpoints: health, waitlist, checkout, subscription status, Lemon webhook, AI coach.
epic: Epic 1 - API Contract and FE-BE Consistency
acceptance_criteria: `openapi.yaml` exists in repo; critical endpoints include request and response schemas; success and error examples are documented.

title: Standardize API error format
description: Implement a single error response shape: `{ code, message, details?, requestId }` across endpoints.
epic: Epic 1 - API Contract and FE-BE Consistency
acceptance_criteria: All endpoints return the standard error shape; OpenAPI documents the shape; frontend consumes `code` consistently.

title: Add requestId propagation
description: Generate a request identifier per HTTP request and propagate it in responses and logs.
epic: Epic 1 - API Contract and FE-BE Consistency
acceptance_criteria: Every response includes `requestId`; server logs include the same `requestId`; request tracing works end-to-end.

title: Setup CI workflow
description: Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml` to run tests and basic checks on pull requests and pushes.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs on push and pull request; `npm test` passes in `comfort-ledger-beta`; failing checks block merge.

title: Add predeploy validation script
description: Create `npm run predeploy:check` to validate critical env vars and release prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: Script fails when critical secrets are missing; checks include session secret and Lemon webhook secret when purchase mode is enabled; release checklist references script.

title: Design data schema v1
description: Define relational schema for users, sessions, waitlist, subscriptions, and webhook events.
acceptance_criteria: Schema document exists; tables and key indexes are defined; migration approach is documented.

title: Implement data access layer
description: Replace direct JSON file access with repository/data-access layer backed by database.
acceptance_criteria: Critical endpoints use repository layer; migrated entities no longer rely on JSON writes; integration smoke tests pass.

title: Build JSON-to-DB migration script
description: Create idempotent migration script for beta users, sessions, waitlist, and subscriptions.
acceptance_criteria: Script is idempotent; migration report shows counts and failures; dry-run mode is available.

title: Document rollback procedure
description: Write and validate rollback plan for failed data migration in staging.
acceptance_criteria: Rollback document exists; staging rollback rehearsal completed; backups are required before production migration.

title: Add webhook idempotency
description: Store and deduplicate Lemon webhook event IDs to prevent double-processing.
epic: Epic 4 - Payments and Webhooks at Scale
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate events do not mutate state twice; event processing states are tracked as processed, duplicate, or failed; automated test covers replay.

title: Create subscription reconciliation job
description: Implement periodic reconciliation between Lemon subscription state and local records.
epic: Epic 4 - Payments and Webhooks at Scale
acceptance_criteria: Manual or scheduled reconcile command exists; mismatches are reported; mismatches can be corrected safely.

title: Harden payment-related endpoints
description: Apply strict email validation, endpoint-specific rate limits, and safe error responses for checkout and portal paths.
epic: Epic 4 - Payments and Webhooks at Scale
acceptance_criteria: Rate limits are enforced on checkout and portal endpoints; invalid emails are rejected consistently; responses do not leak sensitive information.

title: Add critical API integration tests
description: Create integration tests for login, waitlist, checkout creation, subscription status, and webhook flows.
acceptance_criteria: Integration suite runs in CI; success and failure paths are covered; security-sensitive behaviors are verified.

title: Add E2E paid-user flow
description: Automate end-to-end scenario from landing to app access for paying users using staged webhook/payment mocks.
acceptance_criteria: E2E test validates onboarding to paid access; test is deterministic in CI or pre-release environment.

title: Add E2E beta-tester flow
description: Automate end-to-end scenario for beta login, core app usage, session persistence, and logout.
acceptance_criteria: E2E test validates protected routes, session continuity, and logout behavior; test runs in CI.

title: Implement structured JSON logging
description: Adopt structured logs with fields such as level, message, requestId, endpoint, and latency.
acceptance_criteria: Logs are emitted as JSON; sensitive data is redacted; request-linked debugging is possible in runtime logs.

title: Add minimal alerting and SLO signals
description: Set alerts for 5xx rate, webhook failures, and high latency p95 with actionable thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Alert thresholds are defined and deployed; alert simulation confirms delivery; runbook references alert handling.

title: Write incident runbook v1
description: Document response procedures for login outages, webhook failures, and payment access incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook exists in repo; includes detection, mitigation, communication, and recovery steps; on-call checklist is included.

title: Version public API under /v1
description: Introduce API version prefix and migrate current routes to `/v1` while preserving behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Public routes are available under `/v1`; docs are updated; compatibility checks confirm no regressions.

title: Implement basic RBAC roles
description: Add base roles `admin`, `support`, and `user` and restrict administrative endpoints by role.
acceptance_criteria: Role model is persisted and enforced; protected endpoints require expected role; authorization tests pass.

title: Define API compatibility policy
description: Create policy for backward compatibility, deprecation windows, and breaking-change process.
acceptance_criteria: Policy document is in repo; pull request template references the policy; breaking-change checklist is enforceable.
